headline: Top-Ten Clash in Ann Arbor
subhead: Fourth-ranked LSU visits sixth-ranked Michigan in a battle of unbeatens in conference play.

xFactor.why: LSU allows 388 yards per game, ranked ninth, while Michigan surrenders 467, ranked sixteenth.

keyMatchup: Michigan's eighth-ranked offense averaging 407 yards meets LSU's ninth-ranked defense allowing 388.
body: LSU arrives 2-0 with a power poll ranking of fourth after opening the season with two road wins, averaging 32.5 points on 315.5 yards per game while holding opponents to 25.5 points. Quarterback Garr Nussmeier has thrown for 416 yards and five touchdowns, good for tenth in the PCFL, and receiver Scott Cake ranks third with 172 yards and two scores, while ballhawk Kolaj Cobbins leads the league with an interception.

Michigan sits 1-1 and sixth in the poll after a 51-28 home victory over UCLA, averaging 35 points on 407 yards per game but also allowing 35 points and 467 yards. Quarterback Tommie Browne ranks ninth with 467 passing yards and two touchdowns, directing an attack that gains 266.5 through the air and 140.5 on the ground, though the Wolverines have yet to win away from home.
